scope: G8 realized central-bank data + market-pricing/OIS runtime integrity.

core_isolation.rule: Rates/front-end is the primary market translation; realized CB may fill a genuinely neutral rates state; market-pricing/OIS quality does not become a separate core vote.

warnings: USD CB pricing uses a surfaced secondary quote.
GBP CB pricing uses a surfaced secondary quote.
CHF CB pricing uses a surfaced secondary quote.
NZD CB pricing is partial official and must remain explicitly qualified.
safeguards: Incomplete/secondary pricing does not receive an extra vote.
Sovereign Rates and OIS remain separate datasets.
No historical CB/OIS values are fabricated where point-in-time data is unavailable.
conclusion: Current CB/OIS layer is usable. Historical full-engine backtest remains limited by point-in-time pricing depth; current runtime does not hide this limitation.
